paite: I omna lei inn, hiai puanin pen hihsiat in om mahleh van ah inn, khut a lam louh, tangtawn a om ding, Pathian a kipan inn kip i nei uh chih i thei uhi.
Van a kipan i omna ding silhthuah ut mahmah in hiai puanin ah thum chihtak in i thum gige uhi.
Huchibang a silh in om leng vuaktang in i om kei ding uhi.
Eite hiai puanin a i om sung in gik pua in thum petmah in i thum ngal ua, silh lou a om i ut ziak ahi kei a, silhthuah a om i ut ziak ahi zaw, sithei pen hinna valh a a-om theih zawkna ding in.
Huan huai mahmah ding a hon sutuahpa khamna Kha hon pepa Pathian ahi.
Huchi in pumpi a i om lai teng in Toupa kiang ah i om nai kei chih thei in, muangtak in i om gige uhi.
Muthei a pai lou in, ginna in i pai zaw zel uhi.
Muangtak in i om, huan pumpi a om lou a Toupa kiang a om i utzaw hi.
Huaiziak in om in om keita lehang leng, amah kipahpih lam mi hih i tum tinten ahi.
Michih in pumpi a thilhihte asia-apha in, i hih bangbang a i muh chiat theihna ding in, Khrist thukhenna tutphah ma ah hihlat in i om vek ding uhi.
Huchi in Toupa kihtakdan thei in mihingte ka hanthawn zel uhi, koute hihna Pathian kiang ah latsak a om bang in, na sia-le-pha theihna uah leng latsak a ka om uh ka lamen uhi.
heading: Khrist Itna Thahatna

paite: Na kiang uah ka kigenhoih nawn uh ahi kei a, lungtang hilou a, dinmun lel suangte bang ahi hiam dawnna ding na neihtheihna ding un kou lam ah suantheihna hon bawl in ka gen zaw uhi.
Ka hai uleh Pathian a ding in ahi a; ka pil uleh noumau a ding in ahi.
Khrist itna in ahon sawl teitei ahi; hichi in ka ngaihtuah uhi; mi tengteng sih sik in mi khat asi a, huaiziak in mi tengteng asi uhi.
Mi tengteng sih sik a Khrist asihna pen ahingte leng amau a dia ahin nawn louh ua, asih sik ua si a thounawn a ding a ahin zawkna ding un.
Huchi ahih ziak in tuban kou zaw salam ah kuamah ka thei nawnta kei ding uh; salam ah Khrist na theita mah le ung leng; tu'n zaw ka theita kei uhi.
Huchi ahih ziak in, kuapeuh Khrist a a-omleh thilsiam thak ahong hi a; thil luite amangta a, ngai un, ahong thakta hi.
Himahleh bangkim Pathian kiang a kipan a pawt ahi a; ama'n Khrist ziak in amah toh kituak in hon bawl a, kituahna nasepna ahon pia hi.
Huchi in Pathian in Khrist ah khovel amah toh kituak nawn in abawl a, atatleknate uh tatlekna a sehsak lou in, kituah nawnna thu hon kemsak ahi.
Huaiziak in koute Khrist palai nasemte ka hi ua, Pathian in koute tungtawn in ahon ngen ahi. Pathian toh kituakta un aw chi in Khrist sik in ka hon ngen uhi.
heading: Khrist Palaite Thukhah

paite: Amah a Pathian diktatna i hong hihtheihna ding in khelhna himhim thei lou amah Pathian in eite ziak in khelhna in abawl hi.
